cohort: 266 patients with breech presentation admitted to the labor room of two hospitals in Dehradun, India over a 2-year period.
finding: Planned vaginal delivery of breech presentation can be conducted safely in selected patients with proper counseling, intrapartum monitoring, and experienced obstetricians.
mod_finding: Babies delivered by elective cesarean section had higher Apgar scores and birth weights compared to those delivered vaginally or by emergency cesarean section.
gest_age: Ranged from an average of 34.03 weeks for vaginal delivery to 39.17 weeks for elective cesarean.
birth_weight: Average birth weight ranged from 1.819 kg for vaginal deliveries to 2.942 kg for elective cesarean deliveries.
